encryption.title: Mailbox encryption
encryption.transparentHelp: Encrypted at rest. You and your agent read it, including in routines, with no mailbox password. Your organization's admins cannot read it. Whoever runs this Liaison server holds the key. Standard (transparent) mailboxes are read server-side and routines run unattended.
encryption.privateHelp: Only you can read it, on devices where you unlock it with your mailbox password or a passkey. The server cannot read it, so your agent reads it only while your mailbox is unlocked in an open Liaison window. For security, routines and agents can't read private mail while you're offline: those runs wait for you (Run now).
encryption.privateNotAllowed: Your organization does not allow private mailboxes, so new mailboxes are transparent.
encryption.allowPrivateHelp: People can choose a private (zero-access) mailbox. Turning this off makes new mailboxes transparent; mailboxes that are already private stay private.
encryption.makePrivateConfirm: Make this mailbox private? Its mail is re-encrypted so only you can read it, and your agent reads it only while your mailbox is unlocked.
encryption.makeTransparentConfirm: Make this mailbox transparent? This browser decrypts your mail and the server re-encrypts it with the mailbox's own key, so you and your agent read it without unlocking. Keep this page open until it finishes.
encryption.needsPassword: A private mailbox needs a mailbox password. Set it up below, then choose Make private again.
encryption.needsUnlock: Unlock your mailbox to continue: this browser decrypts your mail to re-encrypt it. The move starts as soon as it is unlocked.
encryption.convertingPrivate: Re-encrypting this mailbox so only you can read it…
encryption.notFinished: {{count}} items are still encrypted the old way, so the mailbox has not changed yet. Choose Finish to carry on.
encryption.privateLocked: This Liaison server keeps every personal mailbox private (zero-access): only you can read it.
encryption.stepUpPrompt: To confirm it's you, we email you a code first.
encryption.codeSent: We emailed you a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
encryption.codeNeeded: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you.

disconnectConfirmBody: The conversations, messages, drafts and attachments imported from this mailbox are deleted from Liaison, along with their search results. The mail itself stays in the mailbox. Tickets already created from these conversations are kept.

commercialIdentity.help: Every commercial mail (a follow-up or offer to a prospect) ends with this legal name and postal address, an opt-out link and "or reply stop". Until both are set, Liaison sends no commercial mail.
